Failure mode / cause: CF1 Launch or release permit does not require charging to be off
Effect: Arcing at the connector; damage to the dock or the UAV; possible ignition near the pod

Failure mode / cause: CF2 Charge contactor welded or slow to open
Effect: Arcing at the connector; damage to the dock or the UAV; possible ignition near the pod

Failure mode / cause: CF1 Wrong georeferencing, camera pointing or position estimate passed to the pilot display (IF-PX4-001)
Effect: Walker steered toward a hazard or a person the imagery did not show

Failure mode / cause: CF2 GNSS degradation or spoofing gives a plausible but wrong position
Effect: Walker steered toward a hazard or a person the imagery did not show

Failure mode / cause: CF3 Pilot relies on the UAV picture over direct view and the observer
Effect: Walker steered toward a hazard or a person the imagery did not show

Failure mode / cause: CF1 Link latency, dropped frames or a frozen video stream on the integration link
Effect: Pilot acts on an out-of-date picture of people and obstacles

Failure mode / cause: CF2 Pilot does not notice that the picture is not updating
Effect: Pilot acts on an out-of-date picture of people and obstacles
